6000: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Extend your left leg straight out.
Drive through your right heel to lift your hips.
Lower slowly, finish your reps and switch legs.
6001: Lie on your back with both knees bent.
Straighten your left leg in line with your torso.
Press through the right heel to lift your hips.
Hold for 20-30 seconds with your hips level.
6002: Lie on your back with your knees bent at 90 degrees over your hips.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower one foot to tap the floor.
6005: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Lower slowly without pulling on your neck.
6006: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width.
Reach one arm overhead and lean sideways.
6007: Step one foot forward into a lunge and lower your back knee.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push your hips forward and lift your chest.
Reach your arms overhead if you like.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
6008: Step your right foot forward and lower your left knee to the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push your hips forward and lift your chest.
Reach your arms overhead if you like.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
6010: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Drive one knee up as you raise your arms in a victory pose.
Land lightly and work for 30 seconds.
6011: Stand in a slight squat with your arms out in front.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return your arms forward as you step back.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.
6013: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Kick one straight leg up in front of you.
Switch legs in a smooth rhythm.
6014: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step in place, lifting your knees.
Raise your arms overhead as you step.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds.
6016: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Twist to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
6017: Stand tall with your arms overhead.
Pull your elbows down and in as if doing a pulldown.
Return your arms and foot to start.
Alternate legs at a steady pace.
6019: Lie face down with your arms extended.
Lift your chest, arms and legs a few inches.
Squeeze your glutes and hold for 15-30 seconds.
6024: Lie face down with your arms under your forehead.
Bend one knee to 90 degrees with the sole toward the ceiling.
Lift that thigh off the floor by squeezing the glute.
Keep your hips on the floor.
6025: Lie face down, knees bent and heels together.
Let your knees fall slightly out.
Lift both thighs off the floor by squeezing your glutes.
6026: Get into a side plank on your forearm with your body in a straight line.
Pull your elbow down toward your ribs.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
6027: Stand in a boxing stance with fists up.
Step forward with your lead foot.
Throw a punch as you step.
Alternate sides and keep a steady rhythm.
6032: Sit at the low pulley, feet on the platform, knees slightly bent, and hold the V bar.
Sit tall with your chest up and arms straight.
Pull the handle to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly, keeping your torso still.
Extend your arms slowly until you feel a stretch in your back.
6033: Sit on the floor and lean back slightly.
Extend your legs in front of you.
Pull your knees to your chest as you bring your torso forward.
6034: Set the bar on blocks or a raised platform.
Stand with the bar over your mid-foot.
Hinge and grip the bar just outside your knees.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Drive through your feet to stand tall.
Lower the bar back to the blocks with control.
6035: Sit facing a low cable with a parallel bar attachment.
Hold the handles with your elbows flared.
Lean back slightly with a straight spine.
Pull the handles toward your chest.
6036: Stand facing a high cable and grab the bar with straight arms.
Pull the bar down in an arc to your thighs.
6038: Set the bar of the Smith machine at a low height.
Get on all fours with one foot under the bar.
Press the bar up by extending your hip.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching legs.
6041: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a bottle in each hand in front of your thighs.
Soften your knees and push your hips back.
Lower the bottles along your legs with a flat back until you feel your hamstrings stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Keep your shoulders back and your core braced.
6042: Stand on one leg holding a bottle in each hand, with a slight bend in the knee.
Hinge at the hips and extend the free leg straight behind you.
Lower the bottles toward the floor with a flat back.
Squeeze your glute to return to standing.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
6043: Stand with feet wider than your hips, holding a bottle with both hands.
Hinge back and let the bottle swing between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and let the bottle swing to chest height.
Keep your arms relaxed, the hips do the work.
Let it fall back and hinge into the next rep.
6044: Hold a bottle in each hand at your shoulders, elbows pointing forward.
Sit your hips down and back until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your heels to stand.
6045: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out, holding a bottle with both hands in front of you.
Bend your knees and lower your hips straight down.
Keep your knees pushing out over your toes.
Stop when your thighs are about parallel.
Drive up through your heels and squeeze your glutes.
6046: Hold a bottle in each hand and step into a long split stance.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front heel to rise.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
6047: Stand tall holding a bottle in each hand at your sides.
Lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push off the front foot to return to standing.
6048: Stand tall holding a bottle in each hand.
Step one leg back and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front shin vertical and your chest up.
Push through the front heel to come back.
Alternate legs, or finish one side then switch.
6049: Stand tall holding a bottle in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep your legs almost straight, with a tiny knee bend.
Hinge forward, sliding the bottles down your legs.
Stop when you feel a firm hamstring stretch.
Squeeze your glutes to stand back up.
6050: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a bottle across your hips with both hands.
Push through your heels and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, forming a straight line from shoulders to knees.
6051: Kneel on a mat with hips over knees, holding a bottle at your chest.
Sit your hips back toward your heels.
Pause lightly, keeping your back straight.
Drive your hips forward to return to upright.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
6052: Lie on your back, knees bent, holding a bottle with both hands above your chest.
Extend your arms overhead or keep them over your face.
Curl your ribs toward your hips and lift your shoulders off the floor.
Lower slowly without dropping your head.
6053: Lie on your back with soles together, knees open, holding a bottle on your chest.
Curl your upper body up as you pull your knees in.
Bring your chest toward your knees.
6054: Stand with feet hip-width apart, a bottle in one hand at your side.
Place the other hand lightly behind your head.
Bend sideways toward the bottle without leaning forward.
Return to upright by squeezing your side.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
6055: Sit on the floor, knees bent, and lean back a little with a straight spine.
Hold a bottle with both hands in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side and tap the bottle near the floor.
Keep your feet down or lifted for more challenge.
6056: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, a bottle in each hand.
Squat down with your hips back.
As you stand, raise one arm up and the other down in a wave motion.
Switch arms on the next squat.
Move at a steady, controlled pace.
6057: Lie on your back, knees bent, holding a bottle in each hand at chest level.
Press the bottles straight up until your arms are extended.
Lower slowly until your elbows touch the floor or reach chest level.
6058: Stand tall and press your palms together around a bottle at your chest.
Push the bottle straight out in front of you.
Bring it back to your chest slowly.
6059: Hold a bottle in each hand and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang below your shoulders.
Pull the bottles toward your hips, elbows close to your body.
6060: Lie on your back, knees bent, holding a bottle with both hands over your chest.
Lower the bottle in an arc behind your head.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your sides.
Pull it back over your chest.
6061: Hinge forward with a flat back, a bottle in each hand hanging below you.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
6063: Sit with feet wide, a bottle in one hand, and rest your elbow on your inner thigh.
Curl the bottle toward your shoulder.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
6064: Sit with feet wide, holding a bottle with an overhand grip, elbow resting on your inner thigh.
Curl the bottle up without bending your wrist.
6065: Hinge forward with a flat back, upper arm parallel to the floor, bottle in hand.
Keep your elbow tight at your side.
6066: Hinge forward with a flat back, a bottle in each hand, upper arms parallel to the floor.
Extend both arms straight behind you.
6067: Stand or sit tall holding a bottle overhead with both hands.
Bend your elbows and lower the bottle behind your head.
Extend your arms to lift it back up.
6068: Stand tall with a bottle in each hand, palms forward.
Curl one bottle toward your shoulder.
Lower it slowly as you curl the other.
Keep your elbows by your sides.
6069: Stand tall with a bottle in each hand, palms facing your body.
Curl one bottle up without rotating your wrist.
6070: Stand tall holding a bottle in each hand with palms facing down.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bottles up with straight wrists.
6071: Stand tall holding bottles in front of your thighs, palms facing you.
Pull them up along your body, elbows leading.
Keep the bottles close to your torso.
6072: Hold a bottle in each hand and hinge slightly forward.
Pull your elbows out and up, bottles moving toward your armpits.
6073: Stand tall with a bottle in each hand in front of your thighs.
Raise both arms straight in front to shoulder height.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
6074: Stand tall with a bottle in each hand at your sides.
Raise your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height.
6075: Stand tall with a bottle in each hand.
Raise one arm forward to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly as you raise the other.
6076: Hold a bottle in each hand at shoulder height.
Brace your core and stand tall.
Press both bottles overhead until your arms are straight.
Do not arch your lower back.
6077: Stand tall holding a bottle at chest height with both hands.
Circle it around your head, staying close.
Keep your core braced and ribs down.
Complete the circle back to the front.
Reverse direction on the next set.
6092: Start in a high or forearm plank.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Bring one knee toward the same elbow.
Alternate sides without letting your hips sag.
6094: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your hands out in front.
Lift one knee up and forward to hip height.
Reach both hands under that thigh and tap beneath the knee.
Lower the foot with control and switch legs.
Keep your chest up and stay light on your feet.
Alternate sides at a steady, bouncy pace.
6097: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your hands at shoulder height.
Press both hands straight overhead as you kick one leg back.
Squeeze the glute at the top without arching your lower back.
Bring the hands and foot back to the start.
Switch legs and repeat at a lively pace.
6098: Lie face down with your arms extended in front of you.
Lift one leg slightly off the floor.
Draw small, controlled circles with that leg.
Reverse the direction after several circles.
Lower the leg and repeat on the other side.
Keep your hips pressed down and your core braced.
